description: Spanish weather station observations from AEMET OpenData (official): latest hourly readings (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation…) for all stations or one station ID (idema, e.g. 3195 Madrid Retiro), as published by AEMET. Requires the operator's free AEMET OpenData key. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

station.description: AEMET station ID (idema), e.g. 3195; empty = all stations
